programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish Of The Day
programme.desc: Every Last Bit. Nigel Slater demonstrates the best way to get the very most out of all the ingredients from the weekly shop. He uses leftover ribs to a make the ultimate ragout. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish Of The Day
programme.desc: Try Something Different. Nigel Slater shows how incredibly versatile the ingredients in our fridge can be. He whips up a tasty duck and citrus salad and a chocolate beetroot cake. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish Of The Day
programme.desc: When Nothing Else Will Do. Nigel Slater delivers the ultimate line-up of indulgent treats. These include a slow roast leg of lamb and a truly decadent tumbler trifle. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals For Every Day
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver cooks up tasty, healthy everyday recipes based around simple family meals, mostly using eight ingredients or less in the recipes. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals For Every Day

programme.title: Maneet's Eats
programme.desc: Chicken Biryani. Chef Maneet Chauhan makes chicken biryani with layers of marinated chicken, herbs, rice, saffron milk, cashews, golden raisins and much more. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Nadiya's Fast Flavours
programme.desc: Treat Yourself. Nadiya presents a selection of recipes for feel-good sweet treats, including a no-bake chocolate mint roll and a luxurious creme brulee custard tart. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Dough-lightful Dishes. Guy Fieri is digging into dishes that start with great dough, including venison sopes in Minneapolis and blueberry-basil doughnuts in Montana. S40, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Homeland Favorites. Guy celebrates homeland favourites from diverse cultures. In Minnesota, a Mexican restaurant-market combo serves tacos al pastor and carnitas tamales. S23, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Name That Kitchen. This time, Guy checks out spots that say a lot in the name. In Fort Collins, Colorado, gangster green chilli and mile-high burgers are on the menu! S23, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Beef It Up. This trip, Guy dives into menus boasting about their beef. In Minneapolis, he goes to a neighbourhood gastropub serving up sandwiches piled with steak and braised beef. S23, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Piling On The Pork. Guy Fieri digs in and pigs out on all things pork. After sampling a unique take on tacos in San Antonio, he heads to New Orleans to try pork knuckles. S30, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: A World Of Barbecue. Guy Fieri is exploring an entire world of barbecue. After sampling smokin' chicken salad in Delaware he heads to Kauai for a traditional Hawaiian pig roast. S30, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sausage, Shawarma And Scaloppini. Guy Fieri is on the road to sample all kinds of food. In Delaware, he digs into arancini and veal scaloppini, and samples falafel in San Diego. S30, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: British, Hawaiian And Mexican. Guy Fieri gets a taste of international flavours. A true British pub serves authentic English staples, while a Mexican spot is spicing up shrimps. S30, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Burgers, Bacon And BBQ. Guy Fieri is diving into meaty, savoury goodness. First up on the menu is a pimento cheese burger, followed by kimchi fried rice and prime-time pork ramen. S29, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From Sandwiches To Stroganoff. Guy Fieri is digging into all kinds of hearty meals, from smoked meat sensations to bacon waffles. S29, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Regional Recipes. Guy Fieri is diving into dishes with regional flavour. In California, a real-deal Mexican eatery is serving up Michoacán specialities, like blazing hot molcajete. S29, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Cultural Twist. Guy Fieri dives into cultural cuisine with a twist! First, he visits a cafe that has been serving Scandinavian specialties in Salt Lake City since the 1950s. S29, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Bite Of Britain. This trip, Guy is living it up in London. First, a hip hangout giving classic fish-n-chips a modern makeover. Guy also gets a taste of traditional English fare. S23, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Piggin' Out. Guy is going big on the pig. In Colorado Springs, a funky food truck is serving pork fusion. In Minneapolis, an Asian joint dishes out BBQ pork and pork belly ramen. S23, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Isle-Talian. Guy dives into an island-Italian mashup. In Plymouth, he tries out a unique plantain sandwich. In Colorado Springs, a Caribbean-pasta joint cooks up jerk chicken penne. S23, Ep12

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Tucson. Adam Richman visits Tucson, Arizona for a hot dog wrapped in bacon and covered in all the trimmings, a huge platter of Mexican eats and the massive O.M.G Burger Challenge. S2, Ep18

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Baseball. Adam Richman visits three baseball stadiums known for serving up the most delicious and unique ballpark grub in the USA! S2, Ep10

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Little Rock. Adam Richman visits Little Rock, Arkansas for the mammoth Quadruple Hubcap Burger, a huge community barbecue, and the Shut Up Juice spicy pulled pork challenge. S2, Ep12

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Washington, DC. Adam travels to Washington D.C. for a famed chilli half-smoke, a jumbo fish sandwich, and a giant milkshake-sandwich combo known as the Colossal Challenge! S2, Ep14

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Philadelphia. Adam heads to Philadelphia, Pennsylvania for an Italian roast pork sandwich, a mega ice cream concoction known as Mt. Vesuvius, and the Ultimate Cheesesteak Challenge. S2, Ep17

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: New Brunswick, NJ. Adam heads to New Brunswick, New Jersey, for huge triple-decker deli sandwiches, two-pound Stromboli, and the legendary Fat Sandwich Challenge at a grease truck. S2, Ep19

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Baltimore. Adam Richman's search for the best grub in the USA takes him to Baltimore, Maryland, for some pit beef, blue crabs, and the Great Steak Challenge. S2, Ep13

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Detroit. Adam Richman visits Detroit, Michigan for the massive Triple Threat Pork sandwich, two duelling Coney Dog joints, and the world's biggest burger! S2, Ep15

programme.desc: Lamb. Chef James Martin creates a menu harking back to his childhood. He serves a crayfish cocktail, roast leg of lamb with veg and mint sauce and for dessert, a vodka blancmange. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Big Day
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Peter Graham Scott. Stars Donald Pleasence, Andree Melly, Colin Gordon, Harry H. Corbett and Susan Shaw. Three men anticipate a big promotion in a growing company.

programme.title: Mr. Beamish Goes South
programme.desc: 1953. Mystery. Directed by Oscar Burn & John Wall. Stars John Laurie & Hector Ross. An amateur detective pursues a seaside serial killer who disposes of his female victims in an acid bath.

programme.title: Look At Life Fire Over London
programme.desc: 1966. This film looks at the work of the modern London Fire Brigade - its manpower, equipment and outstandingly efficient communications system.

programme.title: Warn That Man
programme.desc: 1943. Comedy Thriller. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars: Gordon Harker, Raymond Lovell & Jean Kent. During WW II, an impersonator takes part in a German attempt to kidnap Winston Churchill.

programme.title: City Under the Sea
programme.desc: 1965. Fantasy. Director. Jacques Tourneur. Stars Vincent Price, Tab Hunter, Susan Hart. A group of people discover an underwater society of smugglers that never age.

programme.title: Lighthouse
programme.desc: 1947. Drama. Directed by Frank Wisbar. Stars Don Castle, June Lang & John Litel. A love triangle develops between a lighthouse assistant, his elderly boss, and the woman who loves them both.

programme.title: Campbell's Kingdom
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Stanley Baker, Michael Craig, Barbara Murray & John Laurie. A Canadian Rockies landowner leads the fight against a dam builder.

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directors: Seth Holt, Basil Dearden. Stars George Nader, Maggie Smith, Bernard Lee. Paul Gregory is released from jail, following a stretch for robbing a woman who falls for his charms.

programme.title: Look At Life Goodbye Piccadilly
programme.desc: 1967. A spectacular look at the changing face of London's Piccadilly, both above and below ground.

programme.title: Notorious (1946)
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Directed by Alfred Hitchcock. Stars Cary Grant, Ingrid Bergman & Claude Rains. A woman is asked to spy on a group of Nazi friends in South America, but how far will she have to go?

programme.title: The Happiest Days of Your Life
programme.desc: 1950. Comedy. Directed by Frank Launder. Stars Alastair Sim, Margaret Rutherford & John Turnbull. Chaos ensues for staff and students when an all-boys and an all-girls school are merged into one.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Littlecote House/Skiers on Bavarian Alps. 1997. The story of Littlecote House in Wiltshire and a tale of two mountain rescuers who turned to mystical forces while tackling the Bavarian Alps.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro welcomes you into the Cellar Club for an evening of phenomenal horror. Tonight, we begin with Doomwatch - The Red Sky, where the team attempt to solve a deadly mystery.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Red Sky. 1970. Stars John Paul, Aubrey Richards & Jennifer Daniel. Doomwatch investigates when Captain Tommy Gort dies under mysterious circumstances in front of horrified observers.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Are you ready for some grisly tales? Caroline Munro introduces The House of the Dead, an anthology horror film from 1978 directed by Sharron Miller.

programme.title: The House of the Dead
programme.desc: 1978. Horror. Directed by Sharron Miller. Stars John Ericson & Ivor Francis. A man, lost in the rain, is taken in by a mortician who unveils the ghastly origins of four freshly arrived corpses.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: After a frightful night, Caroline Munro takes a look at next week's remarkable features to entice you back into the Cellar Club.

programme.title: The Secret of Seagull Island
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Directed by Nestore Ungaro. Stars Jeremy Brett, Prunella Ransome & Nicky Henson. In Rome, a woman embarks on a chilling journey to find her blind sister who mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: The People That Time Forgot
programme.desc: 1977. Adventure. Directed by Kevin Connor. Stars Patrick Wayne, Doug McClure & Sarah Douglas. An expedition in search of a lost colleague stumbles upon a prehistoric world hidden in the Arctic.

programme.title: Beau Geste
programme.desc: Episode Two. 1982. Stars Benedict Taylor, Anthony Calf, Julia Chambers. The three brothers have returned to Brandon Abbas, when a valuable family heirloom, the 'Blue Water' sapphire, goes missing.
